svg.title: Two Locks on the Robot's Cover Art, and One of Them Is a Decoy
svg.desc: Two padlocks side by side: the left one closed with an intact shackle and keyhole, the right one a decoy with its shackle sprung open and hanging free. Trace Bloom generative banner for “Two Locks on the Robot's Cover Art, and One of Them Is a Decoy”. A isometric lattice probed by 4 emitters; interference blooms mark where the wavefronts meet. Seed 2028889801.
